item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a steady rhythm, with an early start, a midday pause, and a long evening wind-down. Hydration works the same way: it only holds if you build it into that rhythm. Don't wait for thirst. It shows up late, and dehydration quietly dulls focus and mood. Front-load your water in the first half of the day, then taper before bed. Action: drink a full glass of water right now.
